_doc: Generic motion recipes (any story): matched by the figure's own action sentences (verb regex) AND the affordances of the props it holds (tools/stage_props/props.json). First match wins; a book's choreography.json overrides; else tools/motion_batch.py ACTION_MAP. prompt = a body-only HY-Motion phrase (no subject); mode = the impact rule for motion_shot (surface|reach|stop|none); hold = freeze the pose (top|end); from = start|windup; gen_dur = generate this length (a proven clip) and retime to the shot.

recipes.name: strike_tool_held_raised
recipes.prompt: raises a hammer above the right shoulder with the right hand, the left hand low in front of the body, and holds it there, ready to strike

recipes.name: strike_face_on_flat_work
recipes.prompt: leans over a table, pressing down on it with the left hand, raises a hammer overhead with the right hand and strikes down hard once

recipes.name: strike_face
recipes.prompt: raises a hammer overhead with the right hand and strikes down hard, holding tongs low in the left hand

recipes.name: thrust_with_tip
recipes.prompt: lunges forward with the right leg, thrusts a sword forward with both hands and holds the extended thrust

recipes.name: overhead_block_with_edge
recipes.prompt: raises a sword horizontally above the head with both hands to block a blow from above

recipes.name: quench_point_down
recipes.prompt: holds a sword with both hands, point down in front of the body, very still

recipes.name: inspect_blade
recipes.prompt: holds a sword upright in front of the face with both hands, looking at the blade

recipes.name: carried_by_creature
recipes.prompt: hangs limp, arms hanging down at the sides, legs dangling and swaying gently

creature_rules.name: recoil_when_struck
creature_rules.when: a human contact targets this creature's anchor (to = '<creature>:<anchor>')

creature_rules.name: claw_onto_blade
creature_rules.when: the creature strikes and a human holds an edge prop
